verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Innaa arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an ya'tiyahum adhaabun aleem
Qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nadheerun mubeen
Ani-budoo Allaaha wattaqoohu wa atee'oon
Yaghfir lakum min dhunoobikum wa yu'uakhkhirkum ilaa ajalin musamman inna ajala Allaahi idhaa jaa'a laa yu'uakhkharu law kuntum ta'lamoon
Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee laylan wa nahaaraa
Falam yazidhum du'aa'ee illaa firaaraa
Wa innee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'aloo asaabi'ahum fee aadhaanihim wastaghshaw thiyaabahum wa asarroo wastakbaroo istikbaaraa
Thumma innee da'awtuhum jihaaraa
Thumma innee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa
Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kaana ghaffaaraa
Yursilis-samaa'a alaykum midraaraa
Wa yumdidkum bi-amwaalin wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum jannaatin wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa
Maa lakum laa tarjoona Lillaahi waqaaraa
Wa qad khalaqakum atwaaraa
Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allaahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa
Wa ja'alal-qamara feehinna nooran wa ja'alash-shamsa siraajaa
Wallaahu anbatakum minal-ardi nabaataa
Thumma yu'eedukum feehaa wa yukhrijukum ikhraajaa
Wallaahu ja'ala lakumul-arda bisaataa
Litaslukoo minhaa subulan fijaajaa
Qaala noohun rabbi innahum asawnee wattaba'oo man lam yazidhu maaluhu wa waladuhu illaa khasaaraa
Wa makaroo makran kubbaaraa
Wa qaaloo laa tadharunna aalihatakum wa laa tadharunna waddan wa laa suwaa'an wa laa yaghootha wa ya'ooqa wa nasraa
Wa qad adalloo katheeran wa laa tazidiz-zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa
Mimmaa khatee'aatihim ughriqoo fa-udkhiloo naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonillaahi ansaaraa
Wa qaala noohun rabbi laa tadhar alal-ardi minal-kaafireena dayyaaraa
Innaka in tadharhum yudilloo ibaadaka wa laa yalidoo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa
Rabbi ighfir lee wa liwaalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lilmu'mineena wal-mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz-zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa
